name: LSeries.LSeriesSummable_logMul_and_hasDerivAt
statement: ℕ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} (h : abscissaOfAbsConv f < s.re) : LSeriesSummable (logMul f) s ∧ HasDerivAt (LSeries f) (-LSeries (logMul f) s) s

have_tree.name: H
have_tree.body: hasSum_deriv_of_summable_norm h₀ h₁ h₂ h₃ hys

name: LSeries_iteratedDeriv
statement: ℕ → ℂ} (m : ℕ) {s : ℂ} (h : abscissaOfAbsConv f < s.re) : iteratedDeriv m (LSeries f) s = (-1) ^ m * LSeries (logMul^[m] f) s
